188374c08dc4.coverLetter:
Dear Lumen Health Team,

I'm Alex, an interaction designer who builds what I design. Lumen's work on making appointment booking calmer for patients is exactly the kind of problem I want to spend my first years on, and I'd love to join as a Product Designer.

Last spring I designed Pantry, a neighborhood food-sharing app. It started with a class survey: 41 of 60 students said they had thrown away food they could have shared. I ran three rounds of usability testing and raised task success from 58% to 91%, then built the core flow in React so engineers could feel the interactions, not just see them.

This summer at Northwind Studio I designed onboarding screens and a 40-icon set that shipped in a client's mobile app, and built a Figma component library shared by three designers and two engineers.

Outside class, I run our 120-member student design club and mentor first-years, which taught me to give and take critique well.

You can see Pantry and my other work at example.com/alex/work. I'd love to talk about how I could help Lumen's patients.

Best,
Alex
